{"path":"src/t13_cluster.py","content":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

df = pd.read_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
id_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
ind_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

raw = df[ind_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# Median imputation + standard scaling
X = SimpleImputer(strategy="median").fit_transform(raw)
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10).fit(X)
labels = km.labels_

out = df[id_cols].copy()
out["cluster_id"] = labels
out.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False, quoting=1)  # QUOTE_MINIMAL, RFC4180

# Profiles: mean of raw indicator values over non-missing values per cluster
prof = raw.copy()
prof["cluster_id"] = labels
prof = prof.groupby("cluster_id")[ind_cols].mean().reset_index()
prof.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False, quoting=1)

print(out["cluster_id"].value_counts())
print(prof)
"}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

df = pd.read_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
id_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
ind_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

raw = df[ind_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# Median imputation + standard scaling
X = SimpleImputer(strategy="median").fit_transform(raw)
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10).fit(X)
labels = km.labels_

out = df[id_cols].copy()
out["cluster_id"] = labels
out.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False, quoting=1)  # QUOTE_MINIMAL, RFC4180

# Profiles: mean of raw indicator values over non-missing values per cluster
prof = raw.copy()
prof["cluster_id"] = labels
prof = prof.groupby("cluster_id")[ind_cols].mean().reset_index()
prof.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False, quoting=1)

print(out["cluster_id"].value_counts())
print(prof)
